outputs.explanation: Spatial deconvolution plots showing cell population distributions; no significance symbols are present.

The box plot displays **** and *** symbols above each comparison, and the caption explicitly states the exact P value corresponding to each asterisk marking for every immune cell population, so the meaning of each symbol instance is unambiguous.
GSEA enrichment plots report NES, FDR and p values directly as numbers on the plot; no significance symbols/asterisks are used.
Bar graph reports exact p-values printed above each bar; no significance symbols are used.
Panel consists of H&E and IHC micrographs, not a plot with statistical comparisons.
